concepts.learning_objective: Identify the tricks of flattery, false names and lies the young thief uses to win Anil's confidence.
Explain why the narrator judges Anil an easy target and how that judgement proves mistaken.

topics.title: Life with Anil: work, learning and trust

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how Anil's kindness and trust shape his relationship with the boy.
Explain how Anil earns his living as a writer and how this affects his money.
Interpret the narrator's early view of education as a means to get ahead.

topics.title: The theft and the missed train

concepts.learning_objective: Analyse the excuses the narrator gives himself for robbing a trusting man.
Interpret the narrator's unexplained hesitation at the railway station.

topics.title: A night in the rain and the decision to return

concepts.learning_objective: Recall the narrator's study of how different people react when robbed and why Anil's reaction would differ.
Compare the narrator's early and later thoughts about the value of education.
Trace how the lonely, rainy night leads the narrator to reconsider and return the money.
Explain how Anil shows that he knows of the theft yet forgives the boy without a word.
Evaluate how trust and kindness bring about the thief's change of heart.
Identify the author of the story and the first-person point of view from which it is told.
